description: Checks one street address against every compliance list at once (SB 721 balcony citations, LA energy benchmarking, open code cases, soft-story and concrete retrofit orders, industrial stormwater permits) and says which lists name it, with the agency's status, dates and a link to its own record. Free. Covers buildings in the City of Los Angeles. Give the ZIP: without it, the same number and street name in another ZIP can match. Not on a list means the agency's data does not name the address today, not that the building has met the law. About buildings, never people.

address.description: Street address with a house number, e.g. 200 N Spring St.

name: check_compliance
title: Is this address on a compliance list?
